document.title: Strategic Guidance for the Campaign Against Terrorism
document.authors: Office of the Secretary of Defense
document.publisher: National Security Archive (GWU), New Documents Detail America's Strategic Response to 9/11
document.note: [Top Secret] Expansive strategic guidance to DoD for developing campaign plans, specifying threats (terrorist organizations, harboring states including the Taliban and Iraq Baathist Party, WMD proliferation), objectives, means, concepts and campaign elements.

key_claims: The guidance identifies al Qaida as the principal terrorist organization with global reach threatening the US.
The Taliban is listed as a possible target among state regimes supporting terrorists.
The Iraq Baathist Party is named on the same slide as a possible state-supporter target.
The campaign targets states that harbor, sponsor or finance terrorists as well as non-state entities such as banks, foundations and corporations.
The memo envisions a sustained global campaign using all instruments of US power with multiple coalitions tailored to specific purposes.
